nom: Clinique All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate with Retinoid

avis.texte: I chose this product from my 350 rewards points. Love the cooling effect when I dab and apply the tip around the lower eye area. Helps to keep the skin soft. Expensive for the small tube. Would definitely select this if offered for a rewards option.

I have had dark circles under my eyes for years and have tried several other products. But this one, if used according to the directions, works perfectly!! I did try another Clinique product for eyes, but it didn't work nearly as well as this one.

I bought this a couple of months ago after reading the great reviews. I had hope that it would work well for me. (One of my eyes has a puffy area underneath it.) However, after several weeks of use, I have found absolutely no results. None. A complete waste of money.
Love the applicator and product has lightened my undereye circles dramatically. Hydrates, softens, and lightens under eyes. Love it!!
I cant truly rate the product as I never received it. My order was returned by carrier. When I requested to replace order with original discount price i was refused. Very dissatisfied.

I love this product. I initially purchased this to decrease dark undereye spots and fine wrinkles. After a few weeks, i have finally began noticing improvement! My darkness has decreased and my undereye areas are visually more plump with a drastic decrease in fine wrinkles. Though I'd purchase this product again, it is a bit expensive to be such a small tube.

I use this regularly as part of my skincare regimen in the morning and the night I've seen a huge decrease in the fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes and puffiness just a little caveat I forgot it contained a retinoid and was putting an additional retinoid on it so just remember contains a retinoid will burn you if you put another one on
noticeably reduced under eye wrinkles, I was impressed. still looking for something better but this is good!

I actually got this serum as a generous sample from the clinique consultant. I've used All About Eyes before and was not impressed. I have pretty noticeable bags and darks circles and after using the serum *as opposed to the cream* I have definitely noticed an improvement. While it is pricey a little goes a long way.

On Sunday I went into Ulta to look for make up and while I was trying to find my right shade it was working for so the young from Clinique came snd put a cream rather dap it under my eyes and the circles and darkness went away and put then put thev make under my eye oh my goodness it work wonder's no lie I kid you not. My makeup went on smooth i am obsessed with it. I love love it

avis.titre: Didn't Brighten My Eyes & Too Expensive for Amount in Bottle
avis.texte: Unfortunately, just like other's reviews this serum didn't work to brighten my eyes, and for the expensive price, only a small amount is in the squeeze container. I wish I read the reviews. Clinique won't let me return this mediocre product unless I return the gift tote & samples with it. So not only do I get a poor quality product, I also get crappy customer service.

So I followed the instructions 3 times a week in pm, but by the 2nd week day 2, under my eyes stared burning. So I stopped using it. A day later, I have small bumps all under my eyes and cheek that hurt when water or anything touched them. I have been putting hydrocortisone cream on my face for the last 4 days and they are starting to go down but still burn when I wash my face with my clinique soap. I had to stop using my clinique face scrub and clarify lotion because it hurt to put them on face. I hope the bumps are gone by the weekend! I have my husband 50th surprise party!!!!+

avis.titre: I wanted this to work so bad
avis.texte: Maybe I haven't used this enough to see the real benefits of deep puffed eyes, but I don't see a change and now I'm starting to see my eyes watering and they are irritating. I didn't want it to be from this product but it was and I'm so disappointed.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Easy to apply, can easily apply too much if not careful when squeezing the tube. Love the applicator, it makes it effortless to apply. I have noticed a difference in the puffiness under the eyes, only using it a few times a week for the last few months.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The serum has a lightweight, silky texture that glides effortlessly no greasy residue, absorbs instantly .Chilled from the fridge, the cool metal tip adds a refreshing de-puffing touch, especially in the mornings The fragrance‑free, allergy- and ophthalmologist-tested formula reassures those of us with sensitive skin. Depuffs effectively I noticed reduced puffiness within 7–10 days, especially after applying it chilled.
Light serum. Absorbs well. Suits me. The skin under my eyes became slightly better after three weeks of use

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wouldn't really say this helped any. I see a slight difference in darkness but it's not noticeable to me. There's no fragrance, which is nice! It is hydrating and feels nice on the skin. The application is smooth. Effectiveness however isn't on par with other products I have tried. I did use it by instructions, then every morning and night.
used this daily on one eye since i received it. it doesn't look any different than the other eye. not worth it.
Did not notice a difference between All About Eyes and the serum. Have been using All About eyes for several years now. I will stick to that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's a nice product. Nothing too exciting. The rounded metal tip for easy product application is effective. The texture of the product is cool and smooth. No fragrance which is best. If this was marketed as depuffing over brightening, I'd give more stars.

After testing this product for two months, I could say that it was okay at brightening my under eyes. I have quite dark circles, so I wouldn't say it was 100% effective. This eye serum has a really nice texture, but the packaging was a bit inexpensive. I personally wouldn't purchase again, but not a bad product.

avis.titre: Great packaging but this serum did not work for me
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this product for a couple of months now and, sadly, I am disappointed. I really wanted to love this but it missed the mark for me. First off, I absolutely love the packaging! I prefer a tube container for eye treatments and this one is fantastic. The metal tip feels great, glides under my eyes easily, and is super refreshing if left in the fridge between uses. After using this for as long as I have, I expected to see visible improvement in my under eye area and dark circles. That was not the case and I do not see any noticable improvements. I also believe the cost to be exorbitant. Not only because it wasn't effective for me but the product amount vs the price is underwhelming. Unfortunately, this is not a product that I can recommend but I do hope to see more eye products with this package design in the future.
It really helps with the puppy eyes &:dark circles. But expensive!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I underestimated this product! I have been using it going on 2 weeks and I most definitely see a reduction of fine lines under my eyes. Totally recommended.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I noticed significant improvement around my eyes after having used this serum! I used it as directed for several weeks and began slowly but surely noticing a difference! I don't have an extensive skincare routine but this was easy to add in! Bonus points, I liked the smell!

I got this product free in exchange for my honest review. I haven't seen any improvements in my under eye circles. There is a slight warm sensation while using this and it may be fine but I get nervous with that since the skin around eyes is so sensitive and delicate. I will say, I do love the packaging. I love that the tip is a shape that you can use to rub the product i . You can put it in a fridge and it will help with puffiness. So overall i don't like the product but I think the packaging is smart.
I really enjoyed this product. I specifically liked the metal applicator at the end of it because it gives a cooling effect. Overall would recommend This product was sent to me for review

This brightening eye serum is awesome. First, the packaging is fairly standard for an eye product, but I love the cooling sensation from the metal applicator. I don't use it often because I'm a germaphobe, but it is a really lovely feature! This serum actually does what it claims and reduces the appearance of fine lines, brightens dark circles, and calms puffiness. I always feel so glowy and fresh in the morning when I use this before bed!! I do experience some sensitivity when using this serum regularly, but that is expected with any retinoid. I just make sure to take extra care in applying sunscreen and staying out of direct sunlight. This will definitely be a staple in my skincare routine for many years to come. Highly recommend!!
Used this for a while to be able to really a good review and it was ok. Cute packaging and the texture was not bad. I think it didn't make a Huge difference for me but can't hurt to try!
The roller ball is cooling to the under eye and helps with red and puffy eye. I really like it.

avis.titre: My under eyes feel so good!
avis.texte: I've given this product a good trial just to see how it really works. Love, love this product! My under eyes always feel so smooth after using. My dark circles have diminished greatly. Highly recommend!!

I received this product in exchange for a honest review. The texture the look the feel on the skin is all perfect! My eyes have been a bit more sensitive as I've gotten older and this was no problem! I love keeping it in the fridge with the metal applicator it helps with morning puffiness and just helps wake you up. But also is somehow soothing at night before bed! It's something I will keep stocked now!

I really wanted to like this product because I did notice a difference after using it but as soon as I put it on my undereye area burned. I kept using it to see if the burning would cease but it did not.

avis.titre: Honest review after months of use!
avis.texte: Took my time to really try out this product and give my honest opinions and feedback… and I am very unimpressed unfortunately. There was no change in my under eyes after months of use. While the product felt very nice going on and had a great applicator, the formula its self was ineffective for me. I absolutely love Clinique products but this one just didn't hit the mark for me.

I love everything about this product! I'm usually hesitant to put anything around my eyes, but this serum concentrate isn't irritating at all. I received this product complementary to test through Influenster. As a doctoral student, I get some pretty crazy dark circles from late nights studying. This Clinique product nearly erases them after a few uses! I love that it has no scent, and I appreciate how the applicator allows you to directly and smoothly apply to under the eyes!

I really like the smoothness this feels as it's going on. The packaging is good I liked the applicator to put it on. And I find that it made my under eyes look better rather then the dark circles I usually have!
I received this complimentary from Influenster. I like the metal tip as it is cold and refreshing. I didn't notice any significant brightening changes in my under eye appearance.

avis.titre: Like it, but don't love it
avis.texte: To be honest, I'm not sure this is as effective as it should be for the high price point. I do really like how cooling it seems to be, and I enjoyed the minimal packaging, but I wouldn't run to buy it for correcting dark circles.

This goes on so smoothly and the metal tip is cooling on my under eye! I like that it can replace the vitamin c and ha serums I'm currently using daily, as well as the retinoid sticks I use. I received this for free, but I'm excited to add it to my daily regimen (and stop buying those retinoid sticks!)

avis.titre: A must have in your skin care routine
avis.texte: I've been using this serum since I received it, I love how easily it spreads on my skin without leaving my under eyes feeling greasy. It doesn't have a scent which is perfect for those who have sensitivities. The applicator is an amazing added feature that feels cool on my skin. Ilove skin care and while I haven't noticed a difference yet I'll definitely keep using it.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Perfect size for everyday use! I like the metal tip design as it soothes my under eye's bags. Easy to glide and massage without the need for an extra applicator. There is no noticeable scent. The applied area might feel tight and tingle as the product get absorbed to the skin. Give it a try! It will elevate your skincare routine!

avis.titre: Definitely worth adding to my daily skincare routine.
avis.texte: Thank you #influenster and #Clinique for giving me the opportunity to try Clinique's All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate for free. Clinique's All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate is a decent eye serum. The lightweight, gel-like texture absorbs quickly and is fragrance-free, which I appreciate. While I noticed some slight brightening after a few weeks of use, the effect was minimal and didn't significantly reduce my dark circles. The packaging is practical and hygienic. For the price, I expected more noticeable results.
I really like the texture of this product. It doesn't leave my eyes feeling greasy. It soaks in nice and feels nice under my eyes. I like this product.

After receiving this freebto test for my honest review, I found The packaging on this product is great. Compact size to keep handy when ready to apply. I didn't notice a scent. I loved the design of the "roller" it had a cool touch when applying the product. As far as effectiveness, it did seem to help a little bit with my tired, dark, and baggy eyes. I'll continue to use and se.e if it continues to help!

avis.titre: Part of my night sky routine
avis.texte: Packing is perfect for traveling as it has a very good application . No scent and effective for dark under eyes. Price is far and became part of my night routine!

Really enjoyed using this product and seeing the difference it made in the texture of my skin. My husband also ended up trying it and also really enjoyed it. I will definitely be purchasing again. I have sensitive skin, and this did not give me any sort of reaction at all. Great product.
The application is easy and has a nice cooling effect. I did not have any breakouts or irritation from this product. It does take a while to see results.

avis.titre: It was good but not great
avis.texte: I used it , and I kept using it because I wanted so badly to love it but after a few weeks I unfortunately did not notice a huge difference. A difference sure but nothing crazy. I loved the applicator and putting it on always feels like a little massage for my eyes so I loved that!

I followed the instructions on how to use this product and slowly worked up to twice a day use. I am not someone with exaggerated dark circles, but i food feel that this brightened my eyes a little. It's easy to use and apply and has a nice texture to it.

avis.titre: I am obsessed with this eye serum!
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this eye serum! It is so hydrating and illuminates my eyes. I love the applicator most of all. It is easy to use and cool and refreshing to apply. It dispenses effortlessly and comes in the most perfect tube. I am so excited with this new find!

I love the applicator, it feels cool under the eyes and makes application effortless. The product has a perfect consistency, blending seamlessly into the skin. While I can't speak to the long-term effects since I don't have significant under-eye concerns, the immediate moisturizer feel and absorption are impressive.

I've been using the Clinique All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate for a few weeks now. The lightweight formula feels refreshing and cool on my skin, and I love the roll-on applicator-it's so easy to use and gives a nice soothing effect.
The packaging was very pretty, the product itself worked so amazingly well!!!! I went from really dark circles to hardly any in a matter of days. It was amazing!!!

I received this product from Influenster. I have dark circles that are genetic, so nothing can fix that, aside from surgery. That being said, this cream is still great to prevent/treat fine lines. The cooling tip feels nice on my skin, and is convenient to apply the lotion with. I have very sensitive skin, and this did not cause any dryness or irritation. When squeezing the tube, the suction would cause some lotion to fly. No big deal, except the tube is pointed at my eye.
The tube is not the greatest. Feels like Vaseline on your hands and under your eye. Didn't really see or notice a difference. The package is tiny. And not really worth the asking price.
The tube is not the greatest. Feels like Vaseline on your hands and under your eye. Didn't really see or notice a difference. The package is tiny. And not really worth the asking price.

Clinique has been a favorite brand of mine for many years, and their "Clinique All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate" is no exception. The smooth stainless steel tip is amazingly cool in temperature and reduces puff. The serum texture is light, readily absorbs, and is easy to apply. This is a fantastic product and my favorite eye serum to date. It leaves my under eyes feeling refreshed, hydrated, and ready for the day. Added bonus: It's very well packaged and comes in a very attractive box. I love that.
CLINIQUE All About Eyes Brightening Serum works wonders. I've been using it for about 3 weeks now (applying it at night) and can visually notice a difference under my eyes. I would highly recommend.

avis.titre: The applicator is the best part!
avis.texte: First the pros- the applicator! Ahhhmazing! I love how it feels and it's nice and cool to reduce puffiness. Doesn't have an overwhelming smell, but does have an underwhelming ROI. I didn't notice enough of a difference- or really any difference to make it worth the cost. I feel like the ELF roller ball is just as effective for a fraction of the price.

The applicator was cooling to the skin, but be careful when trying to get the product out. It kind of shot some product into the air. I thought the product was mediocre. It didn't make a drastic change to my under eye.

avis.titre: Makes the under eye area look smooth!
avis.texte: The metal applicator tip is cooling and works well. The retinol percentage isn't too high so my eyes did not get irritated, which is rare for me with eye creams. I received this complementary product to review.
This is a beautiful formula for under the eyes. The metal ball-ish tipped applicator makes for a cool sensation application that makes you feel as well as look brighter under the eyes.

I really love the applicator on this, and the texture of it makes it so easy to apply. I've yet to see any notable results, but I do feel like there's a slight improvement after a couple of months of use.

I love this product. It feels very smooth when applying and doesn't have an overwhelming scent. The packaging is very nice. I've been using it for a couple months now and I've already noticed a difference in the way the skin under my eyes looks.

I am loving this eye serum! I can't speak to the long term results, but so far I am liking how lightweight and hydrating this feels. The applicator is my favorite part! Feels cooling on the skin and does a great job of massaging the product in!

I like the texture of this product it is not watery and not too thick. The scent of this product didn't seem to bother me or be too fragrant. I did notice a slight difference using this for a month. I tried to use it often but it seemed to irritate my skin so I used it about 1-2 times a week. I didn't want to try the sandwich method(moisturizer, product and moisturizer) because I wanted to see how effective it was with out it . All in all I will continue to use it

This product was sent to me by influencer and I'm so relieved they did! I've never struggled with super dark under eyes but every once in a while they do look a little like I haven't slept. After suing this product I noticed I looked more awake more often then I did before! Super pleased.
Right after applying my skin looks and feels amazing. The puffiness is lessened. But the affects font last as long as I would like. I will continue using this for sure though.

I have to admit that I'm genuinely surprised how good this is. I'm not the biggest Clinique fan, but this stuff is amazing. The applicator is so convenient and feels so good to my eye. I also have sensitive eyes, and this does not aggravate them. Middle age sucks, but this is my new little friend. Try it out, ladies!

avis.titre: My skin was too sensitive for this!
avis.texte: I wanted to love this and was so excited to try it, unfortunately my sensitive skin was not as excited! I think this would work wonderfully if it wasn't for my sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Love clinique but this one missed the mark
avis.texte: I love clinique and most of their products but I've been consistently using this brightening serum for 2+ weeks and I'm not loving the results as they do seem minimal. I do enjoy the consistency of the product; soft, light and absorbs quickly. I like the application tip as it glides and spreads the product evenly. Thanks to #Influenster and #Clinique for allowing me to receive this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review.

I love this product. I was a happy user of Clinique's first all about eyes cream for years, and decided to try this new serum version. I love the design of the applicator. The tip has a soft cooling effect. After 1 month of consistent use, I've seen an improvement in my under eye puffiness and texture. I got this product as a gift in exchange for a honest review, but I will definitely be purchasing this when I run out!

I am honestly unsure of my opinion of this product, which is why I gave it a neutral rating. The serum feels nice rubbing onto the under eye area as it has a cooling metal tip. I've seen reviews where people say they had instant results with depuffing. Generally, I don't have much of an issue with puffiness under my eyes. On the couple of days I did experience it, I was sure to use the serum to see what would happen. Personally, I didn't notice instant results. As for the brightening, I didn't think to take a before picture to compare to. I haven't noticed a big difference in the black circles under my eyes, but that doesn't mean it didn't improve. I can't be sure. It does feel nice and didn't cause irritation to my very sensitive skin. I will continue to use it and see if it just needs more time to make a notable difference.

I've been using this eye serum for a while now, and I'm really impressed! The cooling rollerball applicator feels so refreshing and helps instantly depuff my under-eyes—especially on mornings when I need a little extra help. The formula is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and isn't greasy at all, which makes it perfect for layering under makeup. I love that it's fragrance-free and gentle on my skin, with no irritation. I've definitely noticed my under-eyes looking brighter and more awake since using it. Plus, a little goes a long way, so the value is definitely there. This has easily become a must-have in my skincare routine!
I was very pleased with how this product was packaged. I love the fact that there is not a presence of a strong scent, the texture is so smooth and feels great while applying the products to eyes.
So far I do like this product, but I haven't seen any real results yet. The texture is smooth and the rounded metal applicator is very cooling and soothing

I received Clinique All about eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate from Clinique and Influenster for my review. This product is easy to use, the applicator is the perfect shape to apply under eyes. The serum contains a powerful retinoid to brighten dull tired eyes. As a busy mom with 5 kids my eyes look tired. You want to use a pea size amount and start out with once at night 3x a week then gradually increase to daily over a 3 week period. This serum was creamy, had no scent, had a cooling feel, and dries quickly. I definitely noticed my eye's looking less tired and dull, so I will gladly continue this product!
I dont like anything with glitter or shimmer, so i always check ingredients lists. I dont see Mica on the list of ingredients… but something in this is putting very tiny glitter on my face.
I have been loving this eye serum. It's lightweight and unscented. The metal applicator makes applying the product very pleasant and cooling. It makes me look and feel more awake.

Clinique's All About Eyes Brightening Serum was just what my eyes needed to look fuller, brighter, and amazing all around. The applicator for this product is perfect, making the product go on smoothly and soak in. A staple in my skin care.

The Clinique all about eyes serum is amazing! Packaging is lovely, and scent was very decent and gives you this comforting feel. Having tried it for a couple of weeks, it's really making my eye skin better and moisturized!
I really enjoy this product. I can't say that I've noticed a difference in skin texture or appearance but I love the application and it feels luxurious to apply.

I like the package and the product. The roller type ball was nice for application. I didn't notice a huge difference after using the product. The biggest thing I didn't like was the fact you had to avoid the sun while using and up to a week after using.

I've been using the Clinique All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate for a few weeks now, and I'm obsessed with the results! The cooling rollerball applicator feels refreshing and helps depuff my under-eye area instantly—perfect for mornings when I wake up with tired eyes. The formula is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly, making it great under makeup. I've noticed a visible difference in brightness and reduced puffiness, which makes me look more awake. It also hydrates without feeling heavy, which is a must for my skincare routine. If you struggle with dark circles, puffiness, or tired-looking eyes, I highly recommend this! A little goes a long way, and the results are totally worth it. Will definitely repurchase!

I be love this Clinique all about the eyes brightening serum. It's really easy to apply. You don't need to put alot…a little goes along way. It smells great and make my skin feel nice. I can tell the difference it made under my eyes. My skin doesn't look as dull as it used to.

I received this product to use in exchange for my honest review from Influenster. I have tried a lot of dark circle serums and eye brightening creams. This has been my favorite so far! I have definitely seen a mild improvement in skin texture and plumpness, but after a month of use the color is about the same. I am hoping over time I will continue to see more and more results. I love the feel of the cream and enjoy the coolness of the applicator. I use this before bedtime and it is a nice little massage along with gua sha and the rest of my skincare routine. I will continue to use and have loved it so much, that this will probably be my new go-to eye cream.
I used them all within about three weeks and noticed some changes, though it's hard to say for sure due to my diet routine. Still, it's definitely worth a try!
I don't notice much of a difference in using this product. It applies lightly and smoothly, leaving no greasy or oily residue. It doesn't have a bad smell, and the packaging is easy to open.

avis.titre: Didn't work well with my skin
avis.texte: I received the CLINIQUE All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate free for my honest review. I wanted to give the product a fair review so I was going to test it for several days before posting my review, unfortunately I had to stop using the product because it caused extreme irritation around my eyes. My eyes are usually not that sensitive and I haven't had issues with other eye creams in the past but this particular I serum really irritated the skin around my eyes. My eyes were extremely red and puffy and the skin felt very sensitive. I don't necessarily blame the product for the irritation I just think it was not the right match for my skin. I would highly suggest doing a skin test before using product around the eyes.

The Clinique all about eyes brightening serum is absolutely gorgeous on your skin. This product has absolutely transformed my under eyes. A little bit goes a long way, it is so hydrating and the the applicator feels cool and luxurious. It doesn't really have a scent which is a plus for me. I highly recommend and will be purchasing in the future!

I received the All About Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate free of charge in exchange for an honest review and I have to say I Love the packaging of this product. With the applicator it has it feels so nice and fresh on the skin!!! It is very easy and simple to use! The texture is creamy and NOT tacky which I love in skincare!! It leaves my under eyes feeling hydrated and looking bright! I don't notice a strong scent but the product itself is amazing
Better than I thought it was going to be. It says to slowly introduce it but I was not irritated at all. Recommend for people with less sensitive skin.

Love the packaging & applicator! Applying this eye serum feels so good - the metal applicator is so cooling and relaxing. A little bit of product goes a long way and I am noticing my under eye area become slightly less puffy as I use the product more frequently. The only reason for 4 stars is that it tends to sting for a short period of time, although it's not bad enough to warrant not using the remainder of the product at least.

I don't usually use an eye cream because I feel like they're typically gimmicky. However, I've been struggling with dark under eye circles and wanted to try this out. The packaging is sleek and the cool metal applicator feels great on the eyes. It doesn't have a strong scent and has a light texture that quickly absorbs into the skin. A little goes a long way and I definitely think this is a valuable product if you're looking for brighter, smoother under eyes.

This cream is beautiful. It moisturizes nicely without causing any milia. The applicator tip feels cool on the skin, and it absorbs I'm quickly. The retinol component is very gentle. It never once irritated my reactive skin. It seemed to smooth out the eye area at the corner of my eye as well.
This stuff works amazing. The packaging makes it incredibly easy to apply under the eyes, and I have found that it leaves my under eyes feeling great.

Packaging was neat and easy to handle. The applicator was nice since it is incorporated into the design and makes it very effective to use and not to waste any product. Not much of a scent since it is fragrence free. Great value.

I was sent this product to try and review. I haven't noticed much of a difference since using this product under my eyes as far as lightning the skin. I do however love the metal tip of the applicator. It's always cold so it helps with eye bags. I think I may need to use this product a little longer to see the lightning of the under eye area.

Clinique All About Eyes serum is highly effective. The cooling texture absorbs quickly, the scent is refreshing, and the packaging is convenient. It reduces puffiness and brightens the under-eye area beautifully!

This is a great serum! I've used a few of these and this is the only one I felt actually brightened my undereye area. I had to stop using it for a few weeks due to a bad sinus infection from traveling but when I was using it, I noticed the circles under my eyes were not as prevalent. The serum goes on smoothly with the applicator and the cap actually keeps the applicator working better than I've seen with other serums!

Love this Clinique eye brightening serum! The applicator is very soothing and the product glides on nicely and absorbs quickly into the delicate skin around my eyes. You really don't need to use much everyday, so 1 tube should last you quite a while! It takes time and patience, but I did see results eventually. Thank you to Influenster and Clinique for gifting me the Clinique All About The Eyes Brightening Serum Concentrate so that I could try it for free.

avis.titre: Love the applicator, formula and texture of cream
avis.texte: I was very glad to have received this product because I had been looking for eye creams. I am quite impressed with this formula as well as the packaging. Directions say to use twice a day but I only use it at night and I have to say that I can see a lot of difference in my under eye area. The area is overall brighter and appears healthier. I love that I don't have to use my fingers to spread the product because the lovely dispenser which also helps spread the product. I was also surprised because vitamin C breaks me out. But this product which contains it, has not made me break out. Love that!

I received this product for an honest review. The packing was nice and I absolutely love that these the tip of the tube is metal which feels good on your face. The cream is light and it goes on smooth. No scent also which I love. I noticed my dark circles did get lighter.

Wow, this is a beautiful eye retinol product! I will be buying again next time. It has improved the look of my milias. They are getting smaller. The undereye fine lines are also smoothing out, and my dark circles are slowly brightening. You need to carefully follow instruction before using to see the best results. The packaging is so nice. The tip is cooling. Also the retinol is strong but also gentle enough for daily use. I only aply it at night though because my skin is sensitive.

I love using this product to brighten my under eyes. This has been added to my daily skin care routine. I have noticed a difference in my under eyes the packing for the products is amazing when you apply it to your under eyes the applicator is very cooling and feels amazing. Definitely recommend this product.

This serum is lightweight and applied easily around the eyes. The applicator feels nice and cooling against skin and make applying the serum very easy. The serum didn't dry out or irritate my skin. After a few weeks of using according to the directions, I have noticed slightly less puffiness but it hasn't significantly brightened under my eyes. I like the formula and will continue to use, but was hoping for more noticeable results.

avis.titre: Seen a difference on my dark under eyes
avis.texte: The cooling effect feels great on my under eyes. It brightens my dark circles under my eyes and I don't look as tired. Also I'm always on the look out for clean ingredients products and this product is non toxic ingredients. Love it

So far, I'm really liking this eye-brightening solution. It reduces puffiness and dark circles, leaving my eyes looking more refreshed and awake. The applicator is cooling—it feels so soothing and helps with absorption. A little goes a long way, and it's not greasy at all. It does have retinoid in it, so if you have sensitive skin, try it in a small area spot first.

avis.titre: Helps brighten my under eye region
avis.texte: After using this product I can say I do notice a slight improvement in the dark circles under my eyes. The instructions are clear and easy to follow: for the first week use just 3 times each night, second week use it every night, third week and beyond use it twice a day. It only takes a small amount to rub in and massage the under eye region. I can tell I used a little too much at first because I felt a slight tingling sensation upon application but after using the right amount, I didn't feel this anymore. The cream comes out of the tube easy, rubs in nicely with no greasy residue and the bottle design is extremely helpful for applying. Am looking forward to continuing using this product consistently (along with actually getting more sleep) to see if my dark circles completely vanish.

This has become one of my favorite products to use!!! I received it a month ago as part of an influenster review program and was greatly surprised about how well it gave my eyes such a bright look and even helped to lighten some of the hyperpigmentation that I had on my cheeks. The cooling sensation it's metal applicator gives makes using the product so enjoyable

avis.titre: I love this soothing under-eye product!
avis.texte: The all about eyes brightening serum concentrate has been very moisturizing for my under eye area. It's comfortable on and has a very cooling application. I love putting this on at bedtime because it feels like a gentle cooling massage for my under eye area and is incredibly soothing. As far as the brightening goes, I think it's too soon to tell any huge difference. But the hydration and cooling effect are enough for me to continue using! *I received this item from influenster in exchange for my honest review.

I have been using this product for about a month and I think it's still a little too soon to report on its "illuminating" qualities. The serum is light weight and comfortable on the skin. The metal tip is a wonderful addition as it adds a cooling sensation that feels great on tired, puffy eyes. I will continue to use this product because it does feel high quality and lightweight. I thoroughly enjoy it!

This eye serum is my favorite product to apply everyday! The smooth metal applicator is cool and refreshing and helps the serum glide right on my under eyes. The cooling effect feels refreshing to start and end my day. The serum itself is the perfect consistency. It's not thin and oily but it's not too thick where it doesn't absorb. It's lightweight but very effective. My under eyes look and feel really good after only about a month of using. They look brighter and smoother! I am very happy with this product I received in exchange for review. I for sure recommend and will be very tempted to purchase when my tube is gone.

avis.titre: Gentle under eye serum w vitamin c & retinol
avis.texte: After using this for the past month or so, I have definitely noticed a slightly smoother appearance in texture under my eyes and my dark circles are a bit brighter. The cool tip metal applicator also had a nice sensation in rubbing the product into that delicate skin. I definitely needed to do the slow ramp up to using it every night so be aware if you do have sensitive skin

Received eye cream complimentary in exchange for a review. So far I really like the serum. It hydrates my dry under eye but I can't say I see a difference in brightness. I will definitely purchase as soon as I finish this tube.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review, I'm really happy I got this product to try out especially since lately I been getting a lot of bad sleep so I have developed dark circles. I have been using it for a couple of weeks before bed and followed the directions on how to use, I have definitely noticed a difference. My under eye area is getting lighter and looks brighter than when I first started. I also love the application tip, it makes it so easy to apply without having to get any product on your hands and gives you a nice cooling effect. The package is also super cute and I haven't had any problems with using it. I'm going to continue using it, I bet I'll see a even bigger improvement in my eyes
